title: phlegmariurus mildbraedii
intro: Phlegmariurus mildbraedii, commonly known as the "Christmas tree fern," is a species of club moss, a type of non-vascular plant. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, where it is believed to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Phlegmariurus mildbraedii include wound healing, reducing fever, and treating digestive issues, among others. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
